# LOAD DATA

```{r}
all_sp <- read.csv("02_Hypervolume/R_Overlap_pairs_wise/results_overlap_all_species.csv")
lentic_sp <- read.csv("02_Hypervolume/Results_Overlap_pairs_wise/results_overlap_Lentic.csv")
lotic_sp <- read.csv("02_Hypervolume/Results_Overlap_pairs_wise/results_overlap_Lotic.csv")

```

# Select lentic vs. lotic species pairs and lotic vs. lentic species pairs

```{r}
species_sp1 = unique(all_sp$sp1)
```

```{r}
species_sp2 = unique(all_sp$sp2)
```


```{r}
sp1_df = as.data.frame(species_sp1)
sp2_df = as.data.frame(species_sp2)

write.csv(sp1_df, "sp1_df.csv")
write.csv(sp2_df, "sp2_df.csv")
```


```{r}
species_group <- read_excel("01_Data/03_Data_species/List_of_species.xlsx", sheet = "species_group")
```


```{r}
head(species_group)
```


```{r}
head(all_sp)
```

```{r}
# First, we group together each species.
all_sp_grouped <- all_sp %>%
  # We add the group information for sp1
  left_join(species_group, by = c("sp1" = "species")) %>%
  rename(group_sp1 = group) %>%
  # We add the group information for sp2
  left_join(species_group, by = c("sp2" = "species")) %>%
  rename(group_sp2 = group)
```

```{r}
# Now we filter: we only keep pairs of species from different groups.
all_sp_filtered <- all_sp_grouped %>%
  filter(group_sp1 != group_sp2)

# result
head(all_sp_filtered)
```


```{r}
#write.csv(all_sp_filtered, "03_Overlap_pairs_wise/results_overlap_LenticVSLotic_species_v1.csv")
```


```{r}
head(lotic_sp)
```


```{r}
# Create three dataframes (one for each type of comparison)
lentico_df <- data.frame(Jaccard = lentic_sp$jaccard, GroupType = "Intra-Lentic")
lotico_df <- data.frame(Jaccard = lotic_sp$jaccard, GroupType = "Intra-Lotic")
lentico_lotico_df <- data.frame(Jaccard = all_sp_filtered$jaccard, GroupType = "Intergroup")

# Combine all dataframes into one
combined_df <- rbind(lentico_df, lotico_df, lentico_lotico_df)
```

```{r}
#head(combined_df)
```

```{r}
colors = c("#ff7f00", "#1f78b4", "#33a02c")

ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = Jaccard, fill = GroupType)) +
    geom_histogram(position = "dodge", bins = 30, alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~GroupType, scales = "free_y") + # Un gráfico por grupo
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) + # <- Aquí aplicas tus colores
    labs(title = "Histograms by Group", x = "Jaccard Index", y = "Frequency") +
    theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Kruskal-Wallis
kruskal.test(Jaccard ~ GroupType, data = combined_df)
```

```{r}
boxplot <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = GroupType, y = Jaccard, fill = GroupType)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "black", aes(fill = GroupType), outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Lentic_Lotic" = "Lentic vs Lotic",
               "Lentic_Lentic" = "Lentic vs Lentic",
               "Lotic_Lotic" = "Lotic vs Lotic")
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Jaccard similarity",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )
boxplot
```

```{r}
#ggsave("Figure_1.png", plot = boxplot, width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```


```{r}
# Post-hoc
library(dunn.test)
dunn.test(combined_df$Jaccard, combined_df$GroupType, kw = TRUE)
```
